changes: Executed Research M0 for the multi-model ablation protocol by adding provider-safe M0 artifacts under experiments/multi-model-ablation, including runner registry, model snapshot lock, cell manifest, Phase 1 budget-lock shape, M0 status table, and a local smoke checker. Review fixes hardened budget-lock source calibration checks and assertion-count reporting.
usage: Run node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m0-smoke-check.mjs to verify M0 artifacts locally. Read experiments/multi-model-ablation/m0-status.md for the milestone table and remaining Phase 1 blockers.
expectedOutcome: M0 should prove the experiment harness can be fairly configured without provider calls, Phase 1/2 execution, outcome records, product gate changes, or multi-model result claims.
actualTranscript: M0 smoke checker passed: 743 assertions; 9 negative controls rejected. lattice validate --story=B-69b8 --json passed 32/32 configured commands with 15/15 verification coverage. done_required_validate passed packages/main build and root npm test.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference from expected M0 behavior. Phase 1 remains blocked until human approval, dated execution snapshots, protocol locks, and real budget locks exist.
limitations: M0 is an audit-only readiness smoke. It does not run providers, does not generate H-M1/H-M3 outcome data, and does not authorize Phase 1 launch.
pitfalls: Review found two real high issues before final pass: budget-lock source rows were not tied tightly enough to A4 calibration cells, and smoke output lacked assertion counts. done_prepare later timed out after internal validation completed, leaving a stale validation lock; waiting past the 120s stale threshold and rerunning done_required_validate resolved it. F-001 managed docs/tooling drift remains medium and out of scope for M0 artifact correctness.
